title: Fonctions L / Équation fonctionnelle des fonctions L (cas géométrique) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page does not belong to the L-function notes around it. It is a typed (mimeographed) page of a Bourbaki draft, rédaction n° 392, page 6-45. It holds exercises on Dedekind domains and discrete valuation rings (DVRs), presumably for Algèbre Commutative, since it refers to 'chap. VI, § 8', the valuations chapter. It was misfiled among Grothendieck's handwritten notes on functional equations of L-functions, between a page on 'cohomologie à l'infini' and a page on normalising L(1/qt)=A(t)L(t).

Exercise 7 d) (end of the exercise): from part c), deduce an example of a DVR A and a separable extension L/K such that the integral closure B is not of the form A[x] for any x. The hint is to start from a cyclotomic extension of Q and use exercise 11 of VI §8. This is the classical phenomenon of non-monogenic local integral closures, in the line of Dedekind's non-monogenic cubic field.

Exercise 8 a): A is a Dedekind domain and L/K is finite separable with B the integral closure. Assume all residue extensions are separable. Then there is x in B with Ω_A(B)=B·dx.
- Proof: Ω_{B/A} is a finite-length torsion B-module, supported at the ramified primes.
- Under residue separability, each completion (or localisation) B_P is monogenic over Â_p, i.e. B̂_P=Â[y] (Serre, Corps locaux III §6). So each local component of Ω is cyclic, generated by dy_P.
- By the Chinese remainder theorem / approximation, choose a global x close enough to each y_P that dx generates locally everywhere.
- Hence Ω_{B/A} ≅ B/𝔇_{B/A}, the different.

Exercise 8 b): give a complete DVR A and a separable L/K whose residue extension L̄/K̄ is purely inseparable and not simple. For example K̄=F_p(s,t) and L̄=K̄(s^{1/p},t^{1/p}), built as in VI §8 ex. 10. Then show Ω_A(B) is not monogenic.
- Proof: the surjection Ω_{B/A}⊗_B L̄ → Ω_{L̄/K̄} has a 2-dimensional target.
- Hence Ω_{B/A} needs at least 2 generators by Nakayama.

All of this is standard textbook material.
errors: 'une extension séparable L du corps des fractions K de L' should read 'K de A' (typo in the original).
'tel que B ne soit de la forme A[x]' omits the 'pas' (stylistic; the meaning is clear).

deep.surprise_reason: This is a misfiled typed Bourbaki draft page of standard exercises on monogeneity and Kähler differentials for Dedekind extensions. It has no connection to the surrounding L-function notes and contains nothing original or unknown.
